messages:
Leah Kim: quick sync: finalizing console observability features for the quarter. primary asks: dashboard rows per-route, cost by model-family, error analytics with reason-categories.
Omar Hussein: Suggest we scope out 3 phases: 1) Est cost + basic traces (MVP), 2) model-version breakdown + alerts, 3) deep traces + raw export.
Becca Tran: Customers want explained errors (e.g., token-limit, model-timeout, decoding-error). we need mapping from infra codes -> human label.
Leah Kim: MVP labels: token_limit, timeout, model_error. show counts + sample trace.
Omar Hussein: Sampling plan: 1% default, 15% for flagged routes. payload: trace_id, route, model_family, duration_ms, tokens_est, error_label.
Becca Tran: UI: show error bucket column and clickable sample. also add note about estimates.
infra-bot: CI: obs-dashboard-tests passed (build 2026-03-21-0810).
Leah Kim: next: Becca to draft error-mapping table, Omar to check cost calc reuse, I'll coordinate beta list.
